roles.name: Mini Finni
roles.summary: 12 complete reactions for the little Finni toy, reused across all 44 reaction slots.
roles.direction: One performer keeps this character consistent. Small, cheeky, and conversational. Record these 12 reactions once; the game reuses them across all toy-hit slots. There are no extra reactions to record.

roles.name: Cake Time host
roles.summary: Cake Time introductions, instructions, jackpots, and timer cues.
roles.direction: A delighted baker guiding the cake celebration. This can be a different teammate from Mini Finni. Keep all Cake Time guidance in this voice.

roles.name: Finni the host
roles.summary: Party welcomes, celebrations, and the first set of party chatter.
roles.direction: Warm, conversational, and a little distracted by preparations. Use one relaxed host character.

roles.name: Party guest · chatter A
roles.summary: A small set of remarks from another guest at the party.
roles.direction: Speak as yourself, warmly and conversationally. A different teammate can own each chatter set. Keep the tone like friends at the same party.

roles.name: Party guest · chatter B
roles.summary: A small set of remarks from another guest at the party.
roles.direction: Speak as yourself, warmly and conversationally. A different teammate can own each chatter set. Keep the tone like friends at the same party.

roles.name: Party crew
roles.summary: A helpful friend announcing tasks, supplies, and party moments.
roles.direction: Friendly and practical. Make task names clear and celebrate completed tasks with a little lift. This 25-line set can go to a teammate who is not recording the instructions.

roles.direction: Clear, friendly, and upbeat. Emphasize the action or reward. A different teammate can record each instruction set; match pronunciation and volume across the team.
